description: Polling email listener: fetches new messages from an IMAP mailbox and fires the trigger for each one. NOT AVAILABLE IN THIS VERSION: the generic listener rail is wired end to end, but the IMAP protocol transport itself is deferred (the integration executor runs HTTP-backed and automation-backed actions only), so a listener on this integration fails loudly on every tick instead of silently reporting an empty mailbox. Connect a Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace mailbox for a working email listener.
credentialGuide:
1. Ask your email provider (or IT admin) for the IMAP server hostname (e.g. `imap.gmail.com`) and port (usually 993 for SSL).
2. If your account has two-factor authentication enabled, generate an app-specific password instead of using your regular password (for Gmail: [myaccount.google.com/apppasswords](https://myaccount.google.com/apppasswords)).
3. Enter the server, username, and password below. Leave Folder blank to use the default INBOX.

configSchema.label: IMAP server
configSchema.helpText: Hostname of the IMAP server (e.g. imap.gmail.com).

actions.description: Fetch messages newer than the highest UID seen so far. DEFERRED: needs the IMAP transport, which the integration executor does not implement (it runs HTTP-backed and automation-backed actions only) — every call is refused with a coded `unsupported_transport` error, never an empty list, which would look like a quiet mailbox.
